scripts.minify:
echo ''; printf '%-60s %12s %12s %12s %10s
' 'File' 'Before' 'After' 'Reduced' 'Savings'; printf '%-60s %12s %12s %12s %10s
' '----' '------' '-----' '-------' '-------'; find dist -name "*.js" -print0 | xargs -0 -P 4 -I {} sh -c 'before=$(wc -c < {}); minify {} > {}.min && after=$(wc -c < {}.min); if [ ${after} -lt ${before} ]; then mv {}.min {}; reduction=$((${before}-${after})); percent=$(awk "BEGIN {printf "%.1f", ${reduction}/${before}*100}"); printf "%-60s %12s %12s %12s %9s%%
" "{}" "${before}" "${after}" "${reduction}" "${percent}"; else rm {}.min; printf "%-60s %12s %12s %12s %10s
" "{}" "${before}" "${after}" "-" "0.0%"; fi'
